entries.name: fig-auditor-rep--action-present--expr-deadpan
entries.instruction: ARM COUNT IS LOAD-BEARING: this figure has exactly TWO arms - one presenting arm held out from the shoulder with the palm turned up, plus ONE other arm; no third limb, no extra shoulder, no spare sleeve, no duplicated forearm anywhere in the frame. Both arms grow from the two shoulders of the one torso and nowhere else.
